extras: Requires local installation of ImageMagick 7. The plugin works locally and makes no network requests.
intentEvidence: It keeps each PNG as the original, creates a same-name WebP companion, and changes only verified image links to use the WebP.
problem: Users need to optimize image file sizes by converting PNG assets to WebP while ensuring the original PNG is preserved and all internal links are correctly updated.

relations.evidence: Creates name.webp beside name.png with ImageMagick 7

summary: A non-destructive desktop plugin that converts PNG images to WebP format, preserves the original PNG, and updates internal links to the new WebP file.
